1051: One who through the Guru has recognised the True One through the Word
ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ; ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
knows He has no family and no mother;
ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
the One alone pervades all, the support of all beings. ॥13॥
ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ; ਧੁਰਿ ਖਸਮਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
but nothing goes along — the Master has so written from the start.
ਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਸਾਚੈ. ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Those who practise Truth from the True Guru — the True One removes their pains. ॥14॥
ਜਾ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
When You give, one finds lasting peace;
through the true Word one practises Truth.
ਅੰਦਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Within is true, mind and body are true; the storehouses overflow with devotion. ॥15॥
He Himself watches and makes all walk by His command;
He Himself makes them do His will.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੭॥
Nanak, those imbued with the Name are detached; the Name has adorned their mind, body and tongue. ॥16॥7॥
He Himself created Himself and became manifest;
ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ; ਜਿਨਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
The Life of the world takes care of all — so knows one who has recognised his own self. ॥1॥
He who created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva
Himself yokes each and every one to their tasks.
ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ; ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Whom He pleases He Himself unites — one who through the Guru knows the One. ॥2॥
The world is coming and going;
in attachment to Maya one thinks of much evil.
ਥਿਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦ ਹੀ; ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
I ever praise the eternal True One — so knows one who has recognised the Guru's Word. ॥3॥
ਇਕਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਲਗੇ; ਓਨੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Some cling to the root and find peace;
those who cling to the branches waste their lives.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ. ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੇ; ਜੋ ਬੋਲਹਿ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
The fruits of nectar grow for those who speak words of nectar. ॥4॥
ਹਮ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਹੀ; ਕਿਆ ਬੋਲਹ ਬੋਲ ॥
We have no virtues — what words can we speak?
You see all and weigh them on Your scales.
ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਰਹਣਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
As it pleases You, so You keep us and so we live; through the Guru one knows the One. ॥5॥
ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਾ; ਤਾ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
When it pleases You, You yoke one to true work;
abandoning faults, one merges in virtues.
ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
In virtue the One pure True Lord is recognised through the Guru's Word. ॥6॥
Wherever I look, there is the One alone;
the evil mind of duality is destroyed through the Word.
ਏਕਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ; ਅਪਣੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਦ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
God, the One, is absorbed in Himself, ever imbued with His own joy. ॥7॥
The lotus of the body has withered;
the ignorant self-willed does not understand the Word.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਖੋਜੇ; ਪਾਏ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
By the Guru's grace one searches the body and finds the Giver, Life of the world. ॥8॥
He removes the sins that seized the fortress (of the body),
ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
who keeps the dear Lord ever enshrined in the heart.
ਜੋ ਇਛੇ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ; ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
He obtains whatever fruit he wishes, dyed like the fast colour of madder. ॥9॥
The self-willed speaks of wisdom, but it is not in him;
ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ; ਠਉਰ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
he comes again and again and finds no resting place.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ; ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
The Guru-facing, with wisdom, ever praises the Lord, knowing the One in every age. ॥10॥
ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ; ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
The self-willed does deeds that bring all sorts of pain;
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਾਹੀ; ਕਿਉ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
the Word is not within him — how can he reach His door?
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ; ਸਦ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
In the Guru-facing the true Word dwells in the mind; he ever serves the Giver of peace. ॥11॥
1052: Wherever I look, You are in all places;
the Perfect Guru has given all this understanding.
ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Meditate on the Name alone, forever and ever; this mind is imbued with the Name. ॥12॥
Imbued with the Name, the body is pure;
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਰਾ ॥
without the Name, people drown and die without water.
ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਹਿ; ਇਕਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
They come and go and do not understand the Name; some, through the Guru, recognise the Word. ॥13॥
The Perfect True Guru has given this understanding:
ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ; ਕਿਨੈ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
without the Name, no one has obtained liberation.
ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Through the Name alone comes glory; one remains in poise, dyed in His love. ॥14॥
The town of the body collapses and crumbles into a heap;
without the Word, the round of births does not end.
ਸਾਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
One who through the Guru knows the One praises the True One and merges in the True One. ॥15॥
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ; ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
One on whom He casts His glance obtains Him;
the true Word comes to dwell in the mind.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ; ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੮॥
Nanak, those imbued with the Name of the Formless are true; at the true door they recognise the True One. ॥16॥8॥
You Yourself are the Creator whose whole creation this is;
all beings and creatures are in Your refuge.
ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
He Himself pervades all, hidden; He is recognised through the Guru's Word. ॥1॥
The Lord's storehouses are filled with devotion;
He Himself bestows reflection through the Word.
ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸਹਿ; ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Whatever pleases You, that alone they do; the mind is imbued with the True One. ॥2॥
He Himself is the diamond, the priceless jewel;
He Himself weighs it on the scales of His glance.
ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
All beings and creatures are in Your refuge; by Your grace You Yourself make Yourself known. ॥3॥
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
One on whom Your glance falls from the start
neither dies nor is born; the round ends.
ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
He sings the praises of the True One day and night, knowing the One in every age. ॥4॥
You created the whole world in attachment to Maya —
Brahma, Vishnu and all the gods.
ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣੇ. ਸੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੇ; ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Those who please You are attached to the Name; through the intellect of wisdom You are recognised. ॥5॥
Sin and virtue pervade the world;
ਹਰਖੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
joy and sorrow — all is heavy pain.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ; ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
One who becomes Guru-facing finds peace, having recognised the Name through the Guru. ॥6॥
No one can erase past actions;
through the Guru's Word is the gate of liberation.
ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
He obtained the fruit of what was written by past deeds — one who, killing self, recognised Him. ॥7॥
ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Through attachment to Maya the mind does not attach to the Lord;
in the love of duality great pain lies ahead.
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ; ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
The self-willed in religious garbs are led astray by doubt; at the last moment they repent. ॥8॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
One who, in the Lord's will, sings the Lord's praises
cuts away all sins and all pains.
ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ; ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ. ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
The Lord is pure, and pure is His Word; the mind is imbued with the Lord. ॥9॥
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ; ਸੋ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
One on whom He casts His glance obtains the Treasure of virtues,
ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣ ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
The One alone is the Giver of virtues and faults — some rare Guru-facing one knows this. ॥10॥
My God is pure, utterly infinite;
He Himself unites, through reflection on the Guru's Word.
1053: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ; ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
He Himself forgives and implants Truth; mind and body are imbued with the True One. ॥11॥
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ; ਵਿਚਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Mind and body are filthy, yet within is the infinite Light;
through the Guru's teaching one understands by reflection.
ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਰਸਨਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Killing ego, the mind is ever pure; with the tongue serve the Giver of peace. ॥12॥
ਗੜ ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ; ਬਹੁ ਹਟ ਬਾਜਾਰਾ ॥
Within the fortress of the body are many shops and markets;
ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ. ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
within it is the utterly infinite Name.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ. ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Through the Guru's Word one is ever beautified at His door; killing ego, one recognises it. ॥13॥
The jewel is priceless, inaccessible and infinite;
what poor creature can appraise its worth?
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੋਲਾਏ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Through the Guru's Word it is weighed, and through the Word it is recognised within. ॥14॥
The Simritis and Shastras are a vast expanse;
the spread of attachment to Maya is spread out.
ਮੂਰਖ ਪੜਹਿ. ਸਬਦੁ, ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Fools read but do not understand the Word; some rare Guru-facing one knows it. ॥15॥
The Creator Himself acts and causes to act;
through the true Word He implants Truth.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੯॥
Nanak, through the Name comes glory; one knows the One in every age. ॥16॥9॥
Serve that True One, the Creator,
who through the Word is the Remover of pains.
ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ. ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ; ਆਪੇ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Inaccessible, beyond perception, His worth cannot be found; He Himself is inaccessible and unfathomable. ॥1॥
The True One Himself makes His true command prevail;
some servants the True One Himself attaches to Himself.
ਸਾਚੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਨਾਮੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
They serve the True One and practise Truth; through the Name they merge in the True One. ॥2॥
From the start He unites the devotees; He Himself unites them,
and He Himself attaches them to true devotion.
ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਇਸੁ ਜਨਮੈ ਕਾ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Through the true Word one ever sings His praises — this is the profit of this human birth. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਹਿ; ਪਰੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
The Guru-facing trade, and recognise others and themselves,
ਏਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
knowing none other than the One (in all).
ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਚੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ; ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
True is the Banker, true are the traders; their capital is the Name, which they purchase. ॥4॥
He Himself fashions and creates the universe;
to some rare one He gives understanding of the Guru's Word.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ. ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ; ਕਾਟੇ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Those who serve the True Guru are true; He cuts away Death's noose. ॥5॥
He breaks and shapes, adorns and fashions;
He has put beings into attachment to Maya and duality.
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਹਿ. ਸਦਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਜਮ ਕਾ ਜੇਵੜਾ ਗਲਿ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
The self-willed wander, ever acting blindly; Death's rope is a noose around their necks. ॥6॥
He Himself forgives and attaches one to the Guru's service;
through the Guru's teaching He enshrines the Name in the mind.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਸਾਚਾ; ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
One who meditates on the Name night and day becomes true; in this world the Name alone is profit. ॥7॥
He Himself is True, and true is His glory;
through the Guru He gives it and enshrines it in the mind.
ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਹਿ; ਤਿਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਚੂਕਾ ਕਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Those in whose minds He dwells are beautified; the burden over their heads is removed. ॥8॥
He is inaccessible, beyond perception; His worth cannot be found;
by the Guru's grace I enshrine Him in my mind.
ਸਦਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ; ਲੇਖਾ ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਮੰਗੈ, ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Through the Word I ever praise the Giver of virtues; no one asks for that one's account. ॥9॥
ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਰੁਦ੍ਰੁ; ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva serve Him;
they cannot find the limit of the Unseen, Inscrutable One.
ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂ ਅਪਣੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Those on whom You cast Your glance, through the Guru, come to see the Unseen. ॥10॥
1054: The Perfect True Guru has given understanding;
I enshrine the One Name in my mind.
ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ. ਤੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ; ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
I chant the Name and meditate on the Name; reaching His mansion, I plunge into His praises. ॥11॥
The servants serve, obeying the command of the Infinite;
the self-willed do not know the worth of His command.
ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੰਨੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਹੁਕਮੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
By His command one obeys, by His command comes glory; by His command one merges in the Carefree Lord. ॥12॥
One who by the Guru's grace recognises the command
restrains the wandering mind and brings it home to the One.
ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤਾ. ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Imbued with the Name, ever detached, the jewel of the Name is in his mind. ॥13॥
ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ; ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
The One alone pervades the whole world;
by the Guru's grace He becomes manifest.
ਸਬਦੁ ਸਲਾਹਹਿ. ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Those who praise the Word are pure; they dwell in their own home. ॥14॥
Your devotees are ever in Your refuge;
inaccessible, beyond perception, Your worth cannot be found.
ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ. ਤਿਉ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
As they please You, so You keep them; through the Guru they meditate on the Name. ॥15॥
Forever and ever may I sing Your praises,
O True Master, that I may be pleasing to Your mind.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ; ਸਚੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੧੦॥
Nanak makes this true prayer: give me Truth, that I may merge in the True One. ॥16॥1॥10॥
Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate;
night and day they are lovingly attuned to the True Name.
ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਰਵਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
The Giver of peace ever pervades their hearts; through the true Word they are uplifted. ॥1॥
When He casts His glance, He unites one with the Guru,
who enshrines the Lord's Name in the mind.
ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਸਬਦੇ ਮਨਿ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
The Lord, ever the Giver of peace, dwells in the mind; through the Word the mind is uplifted. ॥2॥
When He shows mercy, He unites one in union;
ego and possessiveness are burned through the Word.
ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Ever liberated, he remains in the love of the One, with no quarrel with anyone. ॥3॥
Without serving the True Guru there is pitch darkness;
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ; ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਾ ॥
without the Word no one reaches the far shore.
ਜੋ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਹਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Those imbued with the Word are great renunciants; through the Word the True One is their profit. ॥4॥
ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ; ਕਰਤੈ. ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Pain and pleasure the Creator wrote from the start;
He Himself has spread the love of duality.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਵਰਤੈ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
One who becomes Guru-facing remains detached; what trust can be placed in the self-willed? ॥5॥
ਸੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ; ਜੋ ਸਬਦੁ. ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
They are self-willed who do not recognise the Word;
ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਭੈ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ; ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
they do not know the worth of the Guru's fear.
ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ. ਕਿਉ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਜਮੁ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਏਗਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Without fear, how can the Fearless True One be found? Death will draw out the breath. ॥6॥
Death cannot be held back nor killed,
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ; ਨੇੜਿ. ਨ ਆਈ ॥
but through the Guru's Word it does not come near.
ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣੇ ਤਾ ਦੂਰਹੁ ਭਾਗੈ; ਮਤੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Hearing the Word, it flees far away, lest the Carefree dear Lord strike it down. ॥7॥
ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਹੈ; ਸਭ ਸਿਰਕਾਰਾ ॥
All is under the dear Lord's rule;
what can this poor Death do?
ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦਾ. ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ; ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਢਦਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
A servant of the command, it carries out the command; by the command it draws out the breath. ॥8॥
The Guru-facing know the True One made the creation;
the Guru-facing know He spread out the whole expanse.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਬੂਝੈ; ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
One who becomes Guru-facing understands the True One; through the true Word he finds peace. ॥9॥
The Guru-facing, by His grace, know the Creator;
1055: in all four ages He has been recognised through the Guru's Word.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਨਮੈ, ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
The Guru-facing neither dies nor is born; the Guru-facing merge in the Word. ॥10॥
The Guru-facing, attuned to the Name, praise through the Word
ਏਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ; ਸਬਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
The One Name saved the four ages; through the Word the Name is purchased. ॥11॥
The Guru-facing find calm and lasting peace;
the Guru-facing enshrine the Name in the heart.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੂਝੈ; ਕਾਟੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
One who becomes Guru-facing understands the Name and cuts the noose of evil-mindedness. ॥12॥
The Guru-facing merges in the True One from whom he sprang;
ਨਾ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ; ਨ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
he neither dies and is born, nor enters births.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲੈਦੇ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
The Guru-facing remain ever dyed in His love, earning profit night and day. ॥13॥
The Guru-facing devotees are beautified in His court,
adorned by the true Word through the Guru's Word.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
One who sings His praises night and day goes home in poise. ॥14॥
The Perfect True Guru proclaims the Word:
"Worship Him night and day, lovingly attuned."
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਣ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Those who sing the Lord's praises are ever pure — pure are the virtues of the Sovereign. ॥15॥
That True One alone is the Giver of virtues;
some rare Guru-facing one understands this.
ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਬਿਗਸੈ; ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੧੧॥
Nanak, the servant who praises the Name blossoms; that Name is of the Carefree Lord. ॥16॥2॥11॥
Serve the dear Lord, inaccessible and infinite;
ਤਿਸ ਦਾ. ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
His limit cannot be found, nor His near and far shores.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਮਤਿ ਅਗਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
By the Guru's grace, in the heart where He dwells there is unfathomable understanding. ॥1॥
by the Guru's grace He becomes manifest.
ਸਭਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਕਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ; ਦੇਦਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
The Life of the world cherishes all, giving and delivering sustenance. ॥2॥
The Perfect True Guru, understanding, has made this understood:
by His command alone the whole world was created.
ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ; ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
One who obeys the command finds peace; His command is over the heads of kings and emperors. ॥3॥
True is the True Guru, infinite His Word;
through His Word the world is saved.
ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ; ਦੇਦਾ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
The Creator Himself creates and watches over all, giving breath and food. ॥4॥
Out of millions, He gives understanding to some rare one;
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ; ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
imbued with the Guru's Word, they are dyed in His love.
ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
They praise the Lord, ever the Giver of peace; the Lord blesses them with devotion and praise. ॥5॥
Those who serve the True Guru are true;
those who die and are born are the flimsiest of the flimsy.
ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ; ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
The Inaccessible, Imperceptible, Carefree, Unfathomable One loves devotion. ॥6॥
One in whom the Perfect True Guru implants Truth
ever sings His praises through the true Word.
ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਲਿਖਦਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
The Giver of virtues pervades all; on each one's head He writes the appointed time (of departure). ॥7॥
To the Guru-facing He seems ever present;
one who serves through the Word is satisfied.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ; ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Those who serve night and day through the true Word are uplifted by the true Word. ॥8॥
The ignorant, blind one insists on many rituals;
through stubborn-minded rituals one falls back into births.
1056: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ. ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾ ਦੋਰਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
For the sake of Maya they practise greed and avarice; the evil mind leaves them at a crossroads. ॥9॥
One in whom the Perfect True Guru implants devotion
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
fixes his mind on the Lord's Name through the Guru's Word.
ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਮਨਿ ਭੀਨੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
The Lord pervades his mind, body and heart; with the mind drenched, he worships and praises. ॥10॥
My God is true, the Destroyer of demons;
through the Guru's Word, by devotion, He carries across.
ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ; ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
My God is true, ever true, over the heads of kings and emperors. ॥11॥
ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਚੇ; ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
Those devotees are true who are pleasing to Your mind;
ਦਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
they sing kirtan at Your door, beautified by the Guru's Word.
ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ; ਨਿਰਧਨ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵੇਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
They sing the true Word night and day; the Name is the capital of the poor. ॥12॥
Those whom You Yourself unite, You do not separate;
through the Guru's Word they ever praise You.
ਸਭਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ; ਸਬਦੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
You alone are Master over the heads of all; through the Word the Name is praised. ॥13॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ; ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਕੋਈ. ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Without the Word no one knows You;
You Yourself speak the Unspoken story.
ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸੰਬਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
You Yourself are the Word, ever the Guru, the Giver; chanting the Lord's Name, You give it. ॥14॥
You Yourself are the Creator, the Maker;
no one can erase what You have written.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ. ਤੂ ਆਪੇ; ਸਹਸਾ ਗਣਤ ਨ. ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
You Yourself give the Name through the Guru; then anxiety and calculation do not touch one. ॥15॥
The devotees are true at Your court;
they serve You through the Word with loving affection.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਨਾਮੇ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸੋਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੩॥੧੨॥
Nanak, those imbued with the Name are detached; through the Name their affairs are fulfilled. ॥16॥3॥12॥
ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਾਚੈ; ਇਕੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
My True God has staged a play;
ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੇਹਾ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
He has created no one like anyone else.
ਆਪੇ ਫਰਕੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੈ; ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
He Himself makes the differences and rejoices to see them; He has put all tastes within the body. ॥1॥
The instrument of breath plays — You Yourself play it;
He has placed soul and Maya within the body.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ. ਉਲਟੀ ਹੋਵੈ; ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
By the Guru's grace one turns away (from Maya) and obtains the jewel of wisdom, the Word. ॥2॥
He Himself made darkness and light;
the One alone pervades, there is no other.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ. ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ; ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਬੁਧਿ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
One who by the Guru's grace recognises his own self — his lotus blossoms and he gains understanding. ॥3॥
He alone knows His own deep state;
ਹੋਰੁ ਲੋਕੁ; ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
other people only hear and hear, then speak and expound.
ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ; ਸਾਚੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
One who is wise understands through the Guru and sings the true praises. ॥4॥
Within the body is the infinite treasure;
He Himself can open the doors.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ; ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
The Guru-facing drinks the nectar in poise and quenches the fire of craving. ॥5॥
He has put all tastes within the body;
to some rare one the Guru gives understanding of the Word.
ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖੋਜੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ; ਬਾਹਰਿ. ਕਾਹੇ ਜਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
He searches within and praises the Word; why should he go outside? ॥6॥
ਵਿਣੁ ਚਾਖੇ; ਸਾਦੁ ਕਿਸੈ. ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
Without tasting, no one enjoys the flavour;
through the Guru's Word one is given the nectar to drink.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਹੋਏ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਸੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Drinking the nectar, one attains the immortal state; through the Guru's Word one savours it. ॥7॥
ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
One who recognises his own self knows all virtues;
1057: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
through the Guru's Word he chants the Lord's Name.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Imbued with the Name night and day, he casts off attachment to Maya. ॥8॥
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Through serving the Guru one obtains everything,
ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
The Giver of peace Himself shows mercy; through the Guru's Word one is beautified. ॥9॥
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
The Guru's Word is the nectar-bani;
night and day chant the Lord's Name.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਸੋ ਘਟੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
That heart in which the True Lord dwells becomes pure. ॥10॥
His servants serve and praise Him through the Word;
ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
ever dyed in His love, they sing the Lord's praises.
ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ, ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ; ਪਰਮਲ ਵਾਸੁ, ਮਨਿ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Whom He Himself forgives He unites through the Word; the fragrance of sandalwood fills his mind. ॥11॥
Through the Word one speaks the Unspoken and praises
ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ. ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ; ਸਬਦੈ ਕਾ ਰਸੁ. ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
The Giver of virtues Himself unites one through the Word; one savours the Word's delight. ॥12॥
The self-willed strays and finds no resting place;
ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਸੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
he does the deeds written for him from the start.
ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਾਤੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਖੋਜੈ; ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ. ਦੁਖੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Imbued with poison, he seeks poison; he dies and is born, and pain is his lot. ॥13॥
He Himself, all by Himself, praises Himself;
ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹੇ ॥
Your virtues, O God, are in You alone.
ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਸਚਾ. ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੀ; ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
You Yourself are true, true is Your Word; You Yourself are unseen and unfathomable. ॥14॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੇ; ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
Without the Guru, the Giver, no one obtains it,
even if one performs hundreds of thousands and millions of rituals.
ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ, ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
By the Guru's grace He dwells within the heart; through the Word one praises the True One. ॥15॥
ਸੇ ਜਨ ਮਿਲੇ; ਧੁਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Those whom He unites from the start are united;
they are beautified by the true Word, through the Word.
ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੇ; ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ. ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੪॥੧੩॥
Servant Nanak ever sings the praises of the True One; singing His praises we merge in the Virtuous One. ॥16॥4॥13॥
The One alone is unmoving, ever true;
through the Perfect Guru this understanding comes.
ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਭੀਨੇ. ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੀਲੁ ਸੰਨਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Drenched in the Lord's essence they ever meditate; through the Guru's teaching good conduct is their armour. ॥1॥
One with love within is ever true;
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
through the Guru's Word he loves the Lord's Name.
ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਛੋਡਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
The Name, the nine treasures, dwells in his heart; he has abandoned the profit of Maya. ॥2॥
Subjects and kings are in duality through evil-mindedness;
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ; ਏਕੁ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
without serving the True Guru, the One is not realised.
ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ. ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ; ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਤਿਨਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Those who meditate on the One find lasting peace; theirs is an unshakeable kingdom. ॥3॥
No one can save one from coming and going;
birth and death come from Him alone.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ; ਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਤੇ ਪਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Through the Guru ever meditate on the True One; salvation and liberation are obtained from Him. ॥4॥
True self-discipline is at the True Guru's door;
one removes ego and anger through the Word.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਸੀਲੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Serving the True Guru, lasting peace is found; good conduct and contentment are all there. ॥5॥
From the world arise ego and attachment;
forgetting the Name, the whole world perishes.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਨਾਮੁ, ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਜਗਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Without serving the True Guru the Name is not found; the True Name is the profit in this world. ॥6॥
The true command is made pleasing through the Word;
it is as if the five kinds of instruments play together.
1058: ਸਦਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ. ਕਾਰਜੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Through the True Name one's task is ever fulfilled; without the Word, what task is there? ॥7॥
ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਹਸੈ; ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
One moment one laughs, the next one weeps;
through evil-minded duality the task is not fulfilled.
ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਏ; ਕਿਰਤੁ. ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Union and separation the Creator has written; past actions cannot be undone. ॥8॥
One who lives the Guru's Word is liberated while alive,
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
and ever remains merged in the Lord.
ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ. ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
By the Guru's grace he obtains glory; the disease of ego does not touch him. ॥9॥
One who eats all tasty foods and fattens his body,
wears religious garbs but does not live the Guru's Word —
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ; ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
within him is disease, great and heavy pain; he is absorbed in filth. ॥10॥
They read the Vedas, and having read, expound debates;
ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ. ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
God is within the heart, but they do not recognise Him through the Word.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਤਤੁ ਬਿਲੋਵੈ; ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
One who becomes Guru-facing churns out the essence; his tongue savours the Lord's essence. ॥11॥
They leave the treasure in their own home and run outside;
the blind self-willed do not obtain the taste.
ਅਨ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੀ, ਰਸਨਾ ਫੀਕੀ ਬੋਲੇ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੂਲਿ. ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Imbued with other tastes, their tongues speak insipid words; they have no taste at all of the Lord's essence. ॥12॥
Of the self-willed's body, doubt is the master;
through evil-mindedness he dies and is ruined daily.
ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਮਨੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਇਆ; ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ. ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
His mind is attached to lust, anger and duality; not even in dreams does he find peace. ॥13॥
Of the golden body, the Word is the master;
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗੇ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
night and day it enjoys union, in love with the Lord.
ਮਹਲਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗੈਰ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਏ; ਭਾਣਾ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Within the mansions (bodies) it finds the Placeless One; understanding His will, it merges. ॥14॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ; ਨਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
before Him no one has any power.
ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ; ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
He Himself forgives and unites through the Word; His command is unfathomable. ॥15॥
ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
Soul and body all belong to Him;
true is my Master and Lord.
ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੫॥੧੪॥
Nanak, through the Guru's bani the Lord is found; chanting the Lord's chant, one merges in Him. ॥16॥5॥14॥
For the Guru-facing, (the Name) is the yogi's horn and the reflection on the Vedas;
for the Guru-facing, (the Infinite) is wisdom and meditation.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
The Guru-facing does the work that pleases God; the Guru-facing obtains the Perfect One. ॥1॥
The Guru-facing turns the mind back (from Maya);
the Guru-facing sounds the bani as the yogi's horn.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
The Guru-facing, imbued with the True One, are detached and dwell in their own home. ॥2॥
One who utters the Guru's teaching, the nectar-speech,
and through the true Word speaks the True One —
ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
my mind is ever dyed in the love of the True One, merging in the Truest of the true. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ॥
The Guru-facing's mind is pure; he bathes in the pool of contentment;
no filth sticks to him; he merges in the True One.
ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ; ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
He ever practises the Truest of the true and implants true devotion. ॥4॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਬੈਣੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਨੈਣੀ ॥
The Guru-facing has Truth in his words; the Guru-facing has Truth in his eyes;
the Guru-facing practises Truth in his deeds.
ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਅਵਰਾ ਸਚੁ ਕਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
Day and night he ever speaks the True One and leads others to speak it. ॥5॥
The Guru-facing speaks the true, sublime bani;
the Guru-facing utters the Truest of the true.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
The Guru-facing ever serve the Truest of the true; the Guru-facing proclaims the Word. ॥6॥
1059: One who becomes Guru-facing gains understanding,
and casts off ego, Maya and doubt.
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਊਤਮ ਊਚੀ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
The Guru's ladder is sublime and high; at the true door one sings the Lord's praises. ॥7॥
For the Guru-facing, Truth is the self-discipline and the excellent deed;
the Guru-facing finds the gate of liberation.
ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ; ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
Through loving devotion he is ever dyed in His love; losing self, he merges. ॥8॥
One who becomes Guru-facing searches his mind and proclaims:
"Lovingly attune yourself ever to the True Name."
ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ; ਜੋ ਸਚੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
He does whatever pleases Him, whatever pleases the True One's mind. ॥9॥
When it pleases Him, He unites one with the True Guru;
ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
when it pleases Him, He enshrines (the Name) in the mind.
ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ; ਭਾਣੈ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
In His own will one is ever dyed in His love; by His will He enshrines it in the mind. ॥10॥
One who performs rituals through stubborn-mindedness is wasted away;
he wears many garbs, but is not drenched with love.
ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਾਤੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
Imbued with poison, they earn pain and remain absorbed in pain upon pain. ॥11॥
One who becomes Guru-facing earns peace,
and gains understanding of death and life.
ਮਰਣੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ. ਜੋ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ; ਸੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
One who regards death and life alike is pleasing to my God. ॥12॥
The Guru-facing who die (to self) are approved;
recognise coming and going as the Word (His command).
ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜੰਮੈ. ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ; ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
He neither dies nor is born, nor suffers pain; his mind merges in the mind within. ॥13॥
Very fortunate are those who have found the True Guru;
they have driven out ego and attachment from within.
ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ. ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ, ਨ ਲਾਗੈ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
The mind becomes pure, and filth does not stick again; one obtains honour at the true door. ॥14॥
He Himself acts and Himself causes to act;
He Himself watches, establishes and disestablishes.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
Service through the Guru pleases my God; hearing the True Name, He accepts it. ॥15॥
The Guru-facing practises the Truest of the true;
the Guru-facing is pure, and no filth sticks to him.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ; ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੧੫॥
Nanak, those imbued with the Name are reflective; they merge in the Name alone. ॥16॥1॥15॥
He Himself fashioned the whole universe by His command;
He Himself establishes, disestablishes and blesses.
ਆਪੇ ਨਿਆਉ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
He Himself dispenses all true justice; He unites one in the Truest of the true. ॥1॥
The body is a fortress, His visible form;
(but within it) the expanse of attachment to Maya is spread out.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ. ਭਸਮੈ ਕੀ ਢੇਰੀ; ਖੇਹੂ ਖੇਹ ਰਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
Without the Word it is a heap of ashes, dust blending into dust. ॥2॥
The body is a golden fortress of the Infinite,
in which the Word of the Infinite pervades.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਚੇ; ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
The Guru-facing ever sings the praises of the True One, and meeting the Beloved finds peace. ॥3॥
ਕਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
The body is the Lord's temple; the Lord Himself adorns it;
ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ; ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਵਸੈ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
within it dwells the dear Lord, Slayer of demons.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਣਜਨਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ; ਨਦਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
The traders trade through the Guru's Word; by His glance He Himself unites them. ॥4॥
He is pure who removes anger;
through the Word he understands and adorns himself.
ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ; ਆਪੇ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
The Creator Himself acts and causes to act; He Himself enshrines (the Name) in the mind. ॥5॥
those who wash mind and body through the Word become reflective.
1060: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
Night and day one remains ever dyed in His love; by His grace He inspires devotion. ॥6॥
ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ; ਮਨੂਆ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
Within this temple of the body, the mind wanders;
ਸੁਖੁ ਪਲਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ; ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
abandoning peace for straw, it suffers great pain.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ. ਠਉਰ, ਨ ਪਾਵੈ; ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲੁ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
Without meeting the True Guru it finds no resting place; He Himself stages this play. ॥7॥
He Himself is beyond the beyond; He Himself bestows reflection;
He Himself unites, granting the sublime deed.
ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ; ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
What can the poor creature do? He Himself forgives and unites. ॥8॥
He Himself unites one with the Perfect True Guru,
and through the true Word makes one a mighty warrior.
ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
He Himself unites and grants glory; one fixes his mind on the True One. ॥9॥
The True One is within the home (of the heart);
some rare Guru-facing one understands this.
ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
The treasure of the Name dwells in his heart; with his tongue he meditates on the Name. ॥10॥
One wanders in foreign lands but does not search within;
bound by attachment to Maya, he is in the grip of Death.
ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ. ਕਬਹੂ, ਨ ਤੂਟੈ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਰਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
Death's noose never breaks; in the love of duality he wanders. ॥11॥
ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ; ਹੋਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
There is no chanting, austerity or self-discipline of any avail
ਜਬ ਲਗੁ; ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ. ਨ ਕਮਾਹੀ ॥
as long as one does not live the Guru's Word.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
One united through the Guru's Word finds the True One and merges in the Truest of the true. ॥12॥
Lust and anger are powerful in the world;
ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
people perform many rituals — it is all an expanse of pain.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਹਿ. ਸੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
Those who serve the True Guru find peace; He unites them through the true Word. ॥13॥
(The body is) air, water and fire;
attachment to Maya pervades within all.
ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੇ. ਜਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
When they recognise Him who made them, He removes their attachment to Maya. ॥14॥
Some are engrossed in attachment to Maya and pride;
ਜਮਕਾਲੈ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ. ਨ ਪਾਈ; ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
They have no awareness of Death; in the end they depart repenting. ॥15॥
He who created them knows the way;
the one to whom He gives through the Guru recognises the Word.
ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ; ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੧੬॥
Servant Nanak makes this prayer: such a one fixes his mind on the True Name. ॥16॥2॥16॥
From the beginning, through the ages, You are the Merciful Giver;
You are recognised through the Perfect Guru's Word.
ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ; ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
Those who serve You merge in You; You Yourself unite them in union. ॥1॥
You are inaccessible, beyond perception; Your worth cannot be found;
all beings and creatures are in Your refuge.
ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ; ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
As it pleases You, so You make them walk; You Yourself put them on the path. ॥2॥
The True One is, and He shall be;
He Himself creates; there is no other.
ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਆਪੇ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਪਹੁਚਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
The Giver of peace takes care of all; He Himself delivers sustenance. ॥3॥
You are inaccessible, beyond perception, unseen and infinite;
no one knows (the extent of) Your family.
ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਆਪੇ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
You Yourself know Your own self; through the Guru's teaching You Yourself give understanding. ॥4॥
